definitions.gloss: to send back; to return; to ship back
definitions.explanation: To return something to the sender or original location by sending it. Used for packages, products, documents, and also for escorting someone back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不良品|ふりょうひん}→不良品：19452_furyouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{送|おく}り{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: I sent back the defective product.

examples.japanese: ⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}わなかった→合う：10466_au⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{送|おく}り{返|かえ}して⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: The size didn't fit, so I sent it back and had it exchanged.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{不備|ふび}→不備：07599_fubi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{申請者|しんせいしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{送|おく}り{返|かえ}すことになった。
examples.english: Because there were deficiencies in the documents, they had to be sent back to the applicant.

notes:
Godan verb (⟦{五段|ごだん}→五段：28275_godan⟧). Transitive.

A compound of ⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧ (to send) and ⟦{返|かえ}す→返す：09648_kaesu⟧ (to return). The ⟦{返|かえ}す→返す：09648_kaesu⟧ component adds the meaning of returning to the origin.

ASPECT (ている):
- {送|おく}り{返|かえ}した (sent back — completed)
- {送|おく}り{返|かえ}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (is in the process of sending back)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{返品|へんぴん}→返品：05465_henpin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is specifically for returning purchased goods
- ⟦{返送|へんそう}→返送：07344_hensou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is a more formal/written synonym
- {突|つ}き{返|かえ}す means to refuse and send back (more forceful)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{送|おく}り{返|かえ}す (to send back a product)
- ⟦{着払|ちゃくばら}い→着払い：07950_chakubarai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{送|おく}り{返|かえ}す (to send back with recipient paying postage)
- ⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{送|おく}り{返|かえ}す (to send back to the original location)
